description: Take-home pay on a US salary or hourly wage in a state or one of the 50 largest metro areas: federal income tax, Social Security, Medicare, the state's income tax and the state's employee payroll contributions where it has them (disability insurance, paid family leave, long-term care, employee unemployment insurance), using the state's newest published rules with the federal rules of the same year. Single filer, no dependents, standard deduction, wage income only; city and county income taxes are not included. Returns the yearly, monthly and per-paycheck amounts with each tax line and a link to the state's calculator page.

pay.description: Pay before tax: a yearly salary, or an hourly wage with unit hour.

place.description: A US state (ohio or OH) or a large US metro area (austin, seattle). us gives federal taxes only.

unit.description: year (default) or hour; hourly pay is annualized at 2,080 hours.

name: take_home
title: US take-home pay after tax
